title: Form completion #2
topic: Library card · Car rental · Lost property report · Gym membership
context:
Narrator: Conversation 1. Library card.
Helen: City Library, Helen speaking.
Caller: Hi, I've just moved to the area and I'd like a library card.
Helen: How many books would you like to borrow at a time?
Caller: Nine, I think. Actually, let me say eight, it's better to be safe.
Helen: What's your postcode?
Caller: S Y six, seven C B.
Helen: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Whitlock. That's W, H, I, T, L, O, C, K.
Caller: How much is the yearly fee?
Helen: It's twenty pounds.
Helen: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven eight, two six five six, nine nine three four.
Helen: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 2. Car rental.
Tony: Swift Car Hire, Tony speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to rent a small car for a few days.
Tony: When would you like to collect it?
Caller: The first of October, please.
Caller: How much is the insurance cost?
Tony: It's fifty-five pounds... oh, hold on, that's last year's price. This year it's sixty-five pounds.
Tony: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Tony: It's L D six five one nine.
Tony: What's your postcode?
Caller: D B five, one N P.
Tony: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Lockhart. That's L, O, C, K, H, A, R, T.
Tony: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 3. Lost property report.
Mark: Central Station lost property, Mark speaking.
Caller: Hello, I think I left my rucksack on a train yesterday.
Mark: How many items were in the bag?
Caller: Seven, I think. Actually, let me say six, it's better to be safe.
Mark: Let me give you your reference. Have you got a pen?
Caller: Yes, go ahead.
Mark: It's H K eight three seven six.
Mark: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Marsh. That's M, A, R, S, H.
Mark: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven five, one seven two nine, six five six eight.
Mark: What's your postcode?
Caller: N L nine, five X G.
Mark: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
Narrator: Conversation 4. Gym membership.
Sam: Good morning, Riverside Fitness, Sam speaking.
Caller: Hello, I'd like to join the gym, please.
Sam: What's your postcode?
Caller: S K seven, four N R.
Caller: How much is the joining fee?
Sam: It's fifty pounds... oh, hold on, that's last year's price. This year it's sixty pounds.
Sam: When would you like to start?
Caller: The thirteenth of July, please.
Sam: Can I take your surname, please?
Caller: It's Maddox. That's M, A, D, D, O, X.
Sam: And what's the best number to reach you on?
Caller: It's oh seven four, nine seven seven nine, six two nine five.
Sam: Lovely, that's everything. Thank you.
